civilopediaText.text: War Aversion tracks war exhaustion in Major Civilizations (City-States and Barbarians are exempt).
Peace turn: -1 | Enemy defeated: -1 | City conquered (>10): -10
Every 4 points adds 1 scaling step (floor(level / 4)). Capped at 252 points.
From 36 (>35): +2% Unhappiness from Population per 4 pts.
From 56 (>55): -2% Production, -2% Faith, Rebel spawns per 4 pts.
From 100 (>99): -2% Culture, -2% Science, -2% Military Strength per 4 pts.
